tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is 24.2, whereas all pilot observations have H ≤ 0.48. The slow-horizon probe directly resolves the consequential extrapolation ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a dual-exponential model to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow adaptation timescale or long-horizon reversal.
Additional fine short-horizon measurements would be less informative about the target horizon.
The pilot and authorized guidance favor endogenous adaptation, but the slow-horizon probe can discriminate the long-term behavior.
